name: Moutinerie
storyline: The sheep thought they had booked a relaxing vacation on Mêchouîle, the sheep's paradise island. It was a trap set by a crew of pirate wolves. Stranded on an island that reveals itself tile by tile, the sheep must reach a raft, a submarine or another escape route and set sail before being caught, while the wolves hunt them down for their gold coins. Time for a mutiny... a Moutinerie.
summary: Moutinerie is an online board game of sheep versus wolves on a pirate island that reveals itself tile by tile. One to six players take sides: sheep sneak to the escape routes and set sail before they get caught, while wolves track them down and earn a gold coin for each sheep they eliminate. Every tile flipped can change the game: traps, events, items and escape routes. Each pirate has a special power, and outfits and badges can be unlocked. Games are played solo against the computer, pass-and-play on a single screen, or online with friends through a game code or public lobbies. The game is free, without ads or purchases, and runs in the web browser, with iOS and Android apps in beta. It is available worldwide in five languages: English, French, German, Spanish and Italian.
